title: My tasks
description: Keep track of your tasks and find the right help.

open.title: No open tasks yet
open.body: Post what you need help with. Offers from helpers will appear here.

booked.title: No booked tasks yet
booked.body: Once you book a helper, your task will appear here with a link to the booking.

past.title: No past tasks yet
past.body: Completed, canceled, and expired tasks will appear here. Post a task when you need a hand.
